Keeping track of my home server 

<!--more-->


Lots of output
`mount`

Useful to see sizes and percent used
`df -h`

Mount paths with options
`findmnt`

What gets mounted at boot 
`cat /etc/fstab`

Mounts and uuid
`blkid`

More details with sector, unit, id
`sudo fdisk -l`

Manually mount the drive
`sudo mount -t ntfs-3g /dev/sdb1 /media/nathan/Elements`

`UUID=2220418F20416B3D /media/nathan/Elements ntfs-3g rw,auto,user,fmask=0111,dmask=0000 0 0`

https://help.ubuntu.com/community/AutomaticallyMountPartitions

https://askubuntu.com/questions/696043/external-harddisk-detected-but-not-mounting


`nathan@192.168.68.111:'/media/nathan/Elements/TV/'`
